eyebrow.zh: 个人导出 · SQLite 与来源记录

headline.zh:
数据散在不同导出里，
结果仍能回到原始行。
headline.en:
Join exported records.
Keep the source rows in view.

sub.zh: MineKG 将微信文本、支付宝 CSV、特定银行 PDF 和笔记导出整理到 SQLite，建立实体别名关联，并为简单查询返回原始行来源。
sub.en: MineKG imports WeChat text, Alipay CSV, supported bank PDFs and notes into SQLite, links entity aliases and returns source rows with simple aggregate queries.

caption.zh: 问到一个合计，也找得到原始行
caption.en: Get an aggregate with the rows behind it.

body.zh: 异构导出转换为统一 Record，保留来源路径与行号。
body.en: Different exports become Record objects with file and line references.

body.zh: 别名关联结果同时保留需要复核的候选。
body.en: Alias linkage retains candidates that need review.

body.zh: 金额查询返回相应记录，便于核对口径。
body.en: Amount queries include records so the aggregation basis can be checked.

title.zh: 问到一个合计，也找得到原始行
title.en: Get an aggregate with the rows behind it.

body.zh: 同一个人在不同导出中可能使用昵称、全名或掩码姓名，按单份文件检索容易漏掉相关记录。MineKG 将来源记录与别名放进同一张图，再把查询结果连回文件和行号。姓名归并是候选推断，歧义仍需人工检查。
body.en: Nicknames, full names and masked names can split related records across exports. MineKG stores source records and aliases together and links query results back to files and lines. Name grouping is a candidate inference; ambiguous identities still need human review.

body.zh: 仓库三种构造导出产生 11 条记录。规则将“小张”关联到 person:张三，2025 年查询返回 500.00 元，来源是 200 与 300 两条金额记录，同时保留 1 个歧义报告。该合计把金额字段相加，不是把收入与支出相抵后的净额。
body.en: Three bundled synthetic export formats produce eleven records. Rules link 小张 to person:张三; the explicit 2025 query returns 500.00 yuan from two amounts, 200 and 300, while retaining one ambiguity. This sums amount fields; it is not net income minus expenditure.

body.zh: 来源 adapter 产生统一 Record 与 provenance，NER 提取实体，linkage 生成 canonical_id、别名和歧义列表。kg.py 保存 records/entities/aliases 及边；ask.py 根据规则解析人物、时间和 sum/count/avg 意图，再读取关联记录。当前 ask 的 client 参数没有驱动模型生成 SQL。
body.en: Source adapters produce Record objects with provenance, NER extracts entities, and linkage builds canonical IDs, aliases and ambiguity records. kg.py stores records, entities, aliases and edges. ask.py uses rules for person, time and sum/count/avg intent before reading linked rows; its client parameter does not currently drive model-generated SQL.

body.zh: MineKG 将微信文本、支付宝 CSV、特定银行 PDF 和笔记导出整理到 SQLite，建立实体别名关联，并为简单查询返回原始行来源。
body.en: MineKG imports WeChat text, Alipay CSV, supported bank PDFs and notes into SQLite, links entity aliases and returns source rows with simple aggregate queries.

body.zh: 规则链接不是身份确认，金额合计不是完整账务结论。
body.en: Rule linkage is not identity confirmation, and amount aggregation is not a complete accounting conclusion.

note.zh: v0.3.0 的真实规则导入、链接和 SQLite 查询。没有真实个人数据、模型请求或银行 PDF 解析验收；临时数据库结束后删除。
note.en: Real rule-based import, linkage and SQLite querying on v0.3.0. No real personal data, model request or bank-PDF acceptance is involved; the temporary database is removed afterward.

body.zh: 仓库三种构造导出产生 11 条记录。规则将“小张”关联到 person:张三，2025 年查询返回 500.00 元，来源是 200 与 300 两条金额记录，同时保留 1 个歧义报告。该合计把金额字段相加，不是把收入与支出相抵后的净额。
body.en: Three bundled synthetic export formats produce eleven records. Rules link 小张 to person:张三; the explicit 2025 query returns 500.00 yuan from two amounts, 200 and 300, while retaining one ambiguity. This sums amount fields; it is not net income minus expenditure.

body.zh: 需要 Python 3.10+。安装可能联网；自清理示例显式使用规则路径，不读取用户的 MineKG 数据目录或模型配置。
body.en: Requires Python 3.10+. Installation may need network access; the self-cleaning example explicitly uses rules without reading the user’s MineKG data directory or model configuration.

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/minekg.git
cd minekg
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -e .

limitations.zh: 规则链接不是身份确认，金额合计不是完整账务结论。
limitations.en: Rule linkage is not identity confirmation, and amount aggregation is not a complete accounting conclusion.

limitations.zh: 可选模型路径可能向配置服务发送敏感记录片段；示例未调用。
limitations.en: The optional model path may send sensitive record snippets to its configured service; the demo does not call it.
